evals.prompt: Use /webgpt-consult to challenge this architecture decision with the relevant source files and risks.
evals.expected_output: Uses Codex Chrome; builds CONTEXT_PACKET_V1 with task, user intent, local judgment when useful, evidence, options, risks and a fresh sentinel; treats the Web answer as advisory; verifies the result before local integration.

evals.prompt: Ask GPT-5.6 Sol to review this local source directory. It needs several small text files, but uploading them one by one is unreliable.
evals.expected_output: Does not claim ChatGPT Web can read a local path; prefers original selected files when practical; otherwise uses build_attachment_bundle.py for the selected text evidence; refuses silent truncation unless partial bundling was explicitly requested; uploads the resulting real file through Chrome.

evals.prompt: Continue the same consultation. I implemented the previous suggestion and this test still fails.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the verified bound Web conversation; sends a compact delta packet with a fresh task_id and sentinel; reuses the conversation-scoped verified model without reopening the model picker unless an invalidation trigger exists.

evals.prompt: The Markdown packet attachment is visible in ChatGPT, but the composer is empty. Continue without sending an empty request.
evals.expected_output: Reacquires the composer after the upload; verifies rendered prompt text; if exactly one associated Show in text field action exists, uses it once and verifies again; never sends an empty or unverified composer.

evals.prompt: Chrome reset while Send was being clicked and I cannot tell whether the consultation was submitted.
evals.expected_output: Marks dispatch state UNKNOWN; recovers the original tab or exact conversation URL; looks for submission/generation evidence; never opens a replacement consultation or resends while the outcome remains uncertain.

evals.prompt: The same ChatGPT conversation was recovered after the Chrome runtime restarted.
evals.expected_output: Discards old browser locators and pending promises, verifies the same conversation identity, and keeps the cached Web model when no fresh evidence contradicts it; a runtime reset alone does not force a model-picker check.

evals.prompt: The packet contains a real API key and an email address that matters to the business case.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the credential before Send; treats ordinary task-relevant business context as usable when needed; non-blocking privacy warnings are reviewed contextually instead of deleting material that changes the judgment.

evals.prompt: The user says the GPT answer is already visible in the bound Web conversation.
evals.expected_output: Inspects and verifies the existing latest assistant turn and sentinel before preparing another submission; does not duplicate a consultation whose result is already present.

evals.prompt: Start a new consultation on an account where GPT-5.6 Sol Pro is unavailable but GPT-5.6 Sol High is available.
evals.expected_output: Checks the fresh conversation model picker, uses verified GPT-5.6 Sol High when Pro is unavailable, binds High to that conversation, and continues normally instead of failing just because Pro is missing.

evals.prompt: Start a new consultation when there is no valid bound ChatGPT conversation to reuse.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new Skill-owned Chrome tab, navigates it to ChatGPT Web, confirms sign-in and composer readiness, starts from a fresh chat, verifies the eligible GPT-5.6 Sol tier, and does not take over or later close an unrelated user tab.
